subject.title: fix(cron): skip heartbeat-enabled checks for cron-sourced main-session wakes (#101537)

question: Should cron-owned main-session systemEvent wakes bypass per-agent heartbeat scheduler omission when global heartbeats are enabled?
rationale: The bug is concrete, but accepting the fix direction changes explicit per-agent heartbeat configuration semantics for existing users, and automation cannot own that compatibility policy.

options.title: Accept cron override after full fix
options.body: Require the queued scheduler-path fix and real cron proof, then accept cron scheduling as the owner of these wakes while preserving the global disable gate.

options.title: Keep per-agent omission authoritative
options.body: Reject the bypass direction and keep the linked issue open for a different implementation that does not wake agents omitted from heartbeat config.

options.title: Pick one sibling landing path
options.body: Pause overlapping branches until maintainers choose one canonical PR or replacement branch for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Accept cron override after full fix
recommendation.body: Require the queued scheduler-path fix and real cron proof, then accept cron scheduling as the owner of these wakes while preserving the global disable gate.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent cross-boundary signal across heartbeat summary/gate behavior and cron systemEvent delivery.
